newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising on positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising on positive sentiment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) were expected to firm as the market responding positively to the recent change in the leadership of the bourse, brokers said.
Abdul Huq Howlader was appointed Sunday as the new DSE chairman, replacing Imtiyaz Husain, by the DSE governing council.
"The change may continue to have positive effect on the market," said Redwanul Islam of Dastagir Mohammad Adil & Co.
